candidates.description: This vector represents first-, second-, and third-person personal pronouns across various languages.
These tokens represent French words and contractions following an elided apostrophe.
This feature vector represents abstract philosophical, moral, and existential concepts.
This vector represents the concept of existence, being, and related philosophical or ontological terms across multiple languages.
These tokens function as French adverbial modifiers expressing manner, time, degree, or logical connection.
These tokens are conjugated verbs and modal auxiliaries primarily expressing action, ability, or obligation in French and English.
This feature vector represents concepts related to deception, delusion, or distorted perceptions of reality.
This vector represents English and French agent nouns or verbs ending in "-er" and related suffixes.
This feature vector is primarily associated with French demonstrative and indefinite determiners and pronouns.
This vector represents adjectives and adjectival suffixes often used to describe states of possibility, importance, or general qualities.
